attribution-licences.json.attribution: SPDX identifiers only, all verified present in SPDX License List 3.29.0 (2026-09-16). Licences chosen: every Creative Commons BY family id, ODbL, ODC-By, OGL (UK, Canada), Licence Ouverte (etalab-2.0), Datenlizenz Deutschland BY 2.0, NLOD, OGDL-Taiwan, and the permissive software licences MIT, BSD-2/3, Apache-2.0 and ISC (notice retention). cancel-labels.json.attribution: de: 'Verträge hier kündigen' is the wording of BGB § 312k(2) sentence 2; the other de entries and all other locales are authored (only Germany prescribes wording).

consent-models.json.attribution: Authored judgement: `opt-out` = the regime does not require consent before non-essential cookies (CCPA/CPRA and the state laws: opt-out of sale/share; Australia: no cookie-consent rule; sector regimes that do not govern cookies). Every privacy/ePrivacy regime and the national rules are `opt-in`. Counsel review recommended; see spec-changes-c.md item 6.

country-of-origin-labels.json.attribution: Authored; Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules 2020 r. 6 requires the country of origin but prescribes no wording.

digital-product-types.json.attribution: schema.org types verified present in the current vocabulary (SoftwareApplication, WebApplication, MobileApplication, VideoGame, DigitalDocument, EBook) in http and https form, and Product Types Ontology ids (http://www.productontology.org/id/<Wikipedia article>; the service has no https endpoint) of the matching English Wikipedia articles (the service answers for each id; it does not distinguish absent articles, so existence of the article is by knowledge).

dmca-phrases.json.attribution: Authored from 17 U.S.C. § 512(c)(2)-(3) vocabulary (DMCA, designated agent, notice of infringement, counter-notice); translations authored.

dsa-contact-phrases.json.attribution: Statutory wording quoted from EUR-Lex (© European Union, https://eur-lex.europa.eu), reused under Commission Decision 2011/833/EU. 'single point of contact' in each EU language is the wording of Regulation (EU) 2022/2065 Arts 11-12 (checked verbatim). Locales without an official translation (ar, ja, ko, nb, ru, tr, zh) are authored.

dsa-terms-phrases.json.attribution: Statutory wording quoted from EUR-Lex (© European Union, https://eur-lex.europa.eu), reused under Commission Decision 2011/833/EU. restrictions / content moderation / internal complaint-handling terms of Art. 14(1) in each EU language (checked verbatim); other entries and non-EU languages authored.

google-certified-cmps.json.attribution: 124 TCF CMP ids of the web-capable entries (platform Web / Web and app / Web and CTV / Web, app, and CTV) of Google's certified-CMP table (143 rows, list updated weekly). minTcfPolicyVersion 5 = tcfPolicyVersion of the live IAB GVL (TCF v2.3, mandatory for Google ad requests since 2026-03-01 per Google's Ad Manager TCF page).

google-tags.json.attribution: UNPROVEN against Google: Google documents that `gcd` is always sent (consent-mode page) but publishes no letter table. The letters l m n p q r t u v come from two vendor documentations (CookieHub, UniConsent) that agree; see wp/WP-104/spec-changes-c.md item 1. Hosts: Google's CSP guide for the Google tag, with www.google.<TLD> expanded from Google's supported_domains list; `analytics.google.com` is narrowed from the guide's `*.google.com`. `www.google.com` is also used by non-tag Google services (e.g. reCAPTCHA). libraryPaths /gtag/js (server-side tagging guide) and /gtm.js (CSP guide); measurementPaths /g/collect, /pagead/, /ccm/ are the spec's own list, /mp/collect from the Measurement Protocol reference.

market-signals.json.attribution: EU-27 plus IS, LI, NO map to eu-gdpr (the member list is the one the ICO page prints). Currencies: euro and the non-euro EU/EEA currencies. `EU` and `.eu` are an addition (an exceptionally reserved ISO code); see spec-changes-c.md item 5.

marketing-consent-phrases.json.attribution: Statutory wording quoted from EUR-Lex (© European Union, https://eur-lex.europa.eu), reused under Commission Decision 2011/833/EU. withdraw group includes the GDPR Art. 7(3)/13(2)(c) 'withdraw consent at any time' wording in each EU language (checked verbatim); purpose group and non-EU languages authored.

order-button-labels.json.attribution: Statutory wording quoted from EUR-Lex (© European Union, https://eur-lex.europa.eu), reused under Commission Decision 2011/833/EU. Art. 8(2) CRD wording in every EU language (de also BGB § 312j), the Commission's CRD Notice examples 'buy now / pay now / confirm purchase' in every EU language, nb from angrerettloven § 16(2). Remaining entries and ar, ja, ko, ru, tr, zh are authored; 'order now' and 'confirm' are deliberately absent (the Notice rates them less likely to comply).

osa-terms-phrases.json.attribution: Authored from the vocabulary of the Online Safety Act 2023 (illegal content, complaints procedures); the Act's text was not fetched.

prior-price-phrases.json.attribution: Authored from the prior-price rule inserted by Directive (EU) 2019/2161 (the lowest price applied during a period not shorter than 30 days prior to the price reduction; English text fetched); no phrase is quoted from an official translation. UNPROVEN wording for ar, ja, ko, ru, tr, zh, nb.

privacy-notice-elements.json.attribution: Statutory wording quoted from EUR-Lex (© European Union, https://eur-lex.europa.eu), reused under Commission Decision 2011/833/EU. gdpr groups for the 13 EU languages draw on the GDPR Art. 13/14/44-49 wording in that language (first entry where it exists, checked verbatim by wp/WP-104/scripts/part-c-official-check.mjs); ccpa, dpdp and app groups and all non-EU languages are authored from Cal. Civ. Code § 1798.130(a)(5), DPDP Rules 2025 notice content and Privacy Act 1988 APP 1.4.

prop65-link-labels.json.attribution: 27 CCR § 25602(b)(1)(B): 'a clearly marked hyperlink using the word "WARNING" or the words "CA WARNING" or "CALIFORNIA WARNING"'. Translations of the word and of 'Proposition 65' are authored.

provider-id-by-country.json.attribution: GB: SI 2015/17 reg. 25 (part of the UK of registration, registered number, registered office on a website). purpose-phrases.json.attribution: Authored; no statute prescribes the phrases. ja is the primary use (APPI external-transmission notice).

renewal-terms-phrases.json.attribution: Authored (ROSCA, California ARL and CRD prescribe content, not wording).

report-content-labels.json.attribution: Statutory wording quoted from EUR-Lex (© European Union, https://eur-lex.europa.eu), reused under Commission Decision 2011/833/EU. goodFaith = the 'bona fide belief ... accurate and complete' statement of Art. 16(2)(d) in each EU language (checked verbatim). `control` labels are authored (the DSA prescribes no button wording). transfer-adequacy.json.attribution: EU list as of 2026-10-22: AD AR BR CA FO GG IL IM JE JP KR NZ CH GB UY (Brazil: decision dated 2026-01-26; Canada: commercial organisations only; the European Patent Organisation is not a country; US is never listed, DPF is per host). vat-phrases.json.attribution: Authored; no statute prescribes the phrases.
